lines: If that's what you want
Shoot straight through this heart of mine
Even a helpless man like me, someday
If I could become somebody
For no reason at all
Tears about to overflow
Filling up the night
It would become a shining dream
My white breath, faint and frail
Melted away into the winter cold
The warmth of hands we laced together that day
Is far too little to hold on to
Spring, I always believed
Would come to meet me
As a matter of course
That's what I thought back then
When I close my eyes
My dreams, every one of them
I believed they'd come true — back in those days
If that's what you want
I could fly on forever
Even a spineless man like me, someday
If I could find a reason to live
Love and hate
Stitched together with certainty
A dream so dark it never wakes
It would become a dream that lasts a lifetime
Out of the freezing night sky
The two of us slip away
A warm coat
If I gently draped it over you
You, I always believed
Would be beside me as a matter of course
That's what I thought back then
I can never lose it
Even if the rain of memory seeps
Into old wounds
If that's what you want
Shoot straight through this heart of mine
Even a helpless man like me, someday
If I could become somebody
For no reason at all
Tears about to overflow
Filling up the night
It would become a shining dream
Diving through the sea of memory
Gathering up the fragments of love
Inside you, always
A dazzling world, quietly, yeah
Even if this love, like a curse
Slowly, slowly
Eats away at this body of mine
From the depths of my heart
You come spilling out
Reaching for each other, overlapping
Beyond that, let us become the dream
If that's what you want
Shoot straight through this heart of mine
Even a helpless man like me, someday
If I could become somebody
For no reason at all
Tears about to overflow
Filling up the night
It would become a shining dream
Whether it comes true, or it's a dream in reverse
